skills.lede: Skills are steering, and they are files. Oxagen does not run a skill: the harness does. Review what sessions reported, preview approved descriptions, or propose the configuration in a pull request.

inventory.title: Skills sessions reported
inventory.window: Sessions started {from} to {to}: {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}.
inventory.reported: {reported, plural, one {# session reported its skills} other {# sessions reported their skills}}.
inventory.noneReported: No session in this window reported its skills.
inventory.notReported: {count, plural, one {# session reported no inventory} other {# sessions reported no inventory}}.

row.sessions: {count} of {total, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}

empty.title: No skill reported in this window
empty.hint: Enroll a machine with oxagen agent enroll: every wrapped session reports the skills its harness had when it started.

denied.title: You cannot see the skills of this workspace
denied.body: Your roles on this workspace do not include {permission}. An owner can grant it.

pending.title: Access to this workspace’s skills is waiting for approval

error.title: Skills could not be loaded
error.body: Nothing was changed. Runs keep recording while this page is down.

console.searchLead: Preview descriptions against a published configuration and the current repository commit. This loads nothing into a run.
console.unpublished: No configuration is published for the current repository. Skills start off.
console.noMatches: No approved description matched within the score and token limits.
console.withheldLead: Only a human preview includes withheld names. Agent results include counts and reasons.
console.unapproved_digest: Content differs from the approved digest
console.configLead: Configuration changes start in .oxagen/skills.toml. Opening a proposal does not change the published version.
console.readOnly: An organization owner or admin can propose, import, and publish configuration.
console.normalized: This draft reconstructs the published settings. Review the pull request diff, including comments, before merging.
console.proposed: Pull request #{number} is ready for review. The published version has not changed.
console.publishLead: After the PR merges, publish its configuration. Oxagen verifies the merge and reads back the approved commit.

failure.denied: Your role does not allow this action. Ask an organization owner or admin for access.
failure.pending: Access request {id} is waiting for approval.
failure.invalid: Check the configuration, version, and query, then try again.
failure.refused: The action did not complete ({code}). Your draft is still here.
failure.invalidConfig: The TOML does not match the skill configuration format. Check the keys and values before retrying.
failure.notMerged: The PR has not merged into the approved production branch. Merge it there, then publish again.
failure.repositoryMissing: Bind a repository in workspace Repositories before configuring skills.
failure.repositoryChanged: The repository binding changed. Reload the configuration for the current repository.
failure.identityChanged: The repository identity no longer matches its approved binding. Ask an owner to review the repository connection.
failure.branchMissing: The approved production branch is missing. Review the repository settings.
failure.alreadyImported: This repository already has an imported configuration. Publish a merged configuration PR for further changes.
failure.digestChanged: This commit no longer matches its recorded configuration digest. Ask an owner to inspect the repository evidence.
failure.missingVersion: This version is not in the workspace. Reload and select a published version.
failure.catalogInvalid: A skill file has invalid metadata. Correct its name, version, description, and scope before retrying.
failure.catalogTooLarge: The repository contains more than 1,000 skill files. Reduce the catalog before previewing it.
